Dynamic Product Gallery for WooCommerce before 3.6.2 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers with Contributor-level access or above to inject arbitrary JavaScript via the product_id attribute of the [wc_product_dgallery] and [wc_product_dynamic_gallery] shortcodes. The parse_shortcode_product_dynamic_gallery() function passes product_id only through esc_attr(), and get_gallery_main() prints it unescaped into the a3-wc-dynamic-gallery-init-inline-script inline script as part of a JavaScript variable name, so a value such as 342;alert(document.domain)// breaks out of the declaration. The injected script executes in the browser of any user who views the post, including editors or administrators who preview or approve it. 23/11/2026 23/11/2026 Vector CVSS:4.0 CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:L/UI:P/VC:N/VI:N/VA:N/SC:L/SI:L/SA:N/E:X/CR:X/IR:X/AR:X/MAV:X/MAC:X/MAT:X/MPR:X/MUI:X/MVC:X/MVI:X/MVA:X/MSC:X/MSI:X/MSA:X/S:X/AU:X/R:X/V:X/RE:X/U:X Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:R/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N Gravedad 4.0 5.10 Gravedad 4.0 txt MEDIUM Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 5.40 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) MEDIUM

A weakness has been identified in FredrikNoren ungit 1.5.30. Affected by this issue is the function credentialsOption of the file source/git-api.js of the component Remote Git API. Executing a manipulation of the argument Remote can lead to os command injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. DreameHome cloud API before 2026-10-14 contained an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the POST /smart-app/meari-cloud/redirectAndLogin endpoint that allows authenticated attackers to obtain another user's Meari camera-platform identity and session credentials by supplying that user's uid. The endpoint used the caller-supplied uid to select the Meari account without verifying that it belonged to the account authenticated by the Dreame-Auth token. Attackers can obtain target uids through public forum profiles and an email-to-uid lookup, and use the leaked credentials to access live video, microphone audio, the camera speaker, and stored recordings of Meari-backed cameras. 23/11/2026 23/11/2026 Vector CVSS:4.0 CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:L/UI:N/VC:H/VI:N/VA:N/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N/E:X/CR:X/IR:X/AR:X/MAV:X/MAC:X/MAT:X/MPR:X/MUI:X/MVC:X/MVI:X/MVA:X/MSC:X/MSI:X/MSA:X/S:X/AU:X/R:X/V:X/RE:X/U:X Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N Gravedad 4.0 7.10 Gravedad 4.0 txt HIGH Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 6.50 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) MEDIUM
